title: Mechanical or electrical engineer
what: Designs, tests and improves the parts, machines and production lines used in factories and aircraft.

title: CNC machinist / setter-operator
what: Sets up and runs computer-controlled machines that cut and shape metal parts precisely.

title: Fabricator or welder
what: Joins and shapes metal to build aircraft parts, vehicles and structures.

title: Electrical engineer or technician
what: Installs, tests and maintains the electrical systems inside factories and products.

title: Manufacturing data analyst
what: Uses data from smart factories to spot problems early and improve production.

title: Production manager
what: Leads a manufacturing team, planning schedules and keeping quality and safety high.

title: Bricklayer
what: Builds and repairs walls and structures using brick, block and stone.

title: Plumber or heating engineer
what: Installs and maintains the water, heating and drainage systems inside buildings.

title: Carpenter or joiner
what: Makes and fits the wooden structures and fittings used on building sites.

title: Electrician (construction)
what: Wires and maintains the electrical systems in new and existing buildings.

title: Construction site manager
what: Oversees a building site day to day, coordinating trades, safety and deadlines.

title: Chef
what: Prepares and cooks food in restaurants, hotels and visitor attractions.

title: Front of house or guest services assistant
what: Welcomes and looks after guests in hotels, restaurants and attractions.

title: Hospitality or leisure manager
what: Runs a hotel, restaurant, bar or leisure venue on a day-to-day basis.

title: Leisure and tourism assistant
what: Helps run attractions, activities and events for visitors.

title: Care worker or home carer
what: Supports people with daily living, in their own home or in a care setting.

title: Senior care worker
what: Leads shifts and mentors newer care workers.

title: Registered care manager
what: Runs a care home or care service and answers to inspectors.

title: Social worker
what: Works with people and families facing difficulties, arranging support and safeguarding.

title: Software developer / programmer
what: Builds and tests the software and apps that businesses rely on.

title: Cyber security analyst
what: Protects computer systems and data from attacks and breaches.

title: Web designer or developer
what: Designs and builds the websites and online services people use every day.

title: IT support technician
what: Keeps computers, networks and software running for a business.

title: Data or systems analyst
what: Studies how a business's systems and data work and suggests improvements.

title: Aerospace engineer
what: Designs and improves aircraft and defence systems, for example at BAE Systems.

title: Electronics or systems technician
what: Tests and integrates the electronics inside defence and aerospace equipment.

title: Cyber security specialist
what: Defends the UK's networks and data, including at the new National Cyber Force site in Samlesbury.

title: Quality assurance engineer
what: Checks that safety-critical parts meet strict defence and aerospace standards.

title: Food technologist or production technician
what: Keeps food production safe, efficient and high quality, from farm to factory.

title: Nuclear technician
what: Operates and maintains equipment at nuclear sites such as Heysham or Springfields.

title: Nuclear or mechanical engineer
what: Designs and manages the equipment and processes behind nuclear power and fuel.

title: Wind turbine or engineering technician
what: Installs and maintains offshore and onshore wind turbines.

title: Environmental or health & safety officer
what: Makes sure energy sites meet environmental and safety rules.
